support_scope: Governance cleanup for deferred and no-new-development language/surface artifacts. The track records canonical support vocabulary, audience/owner gates, no-formula-duplication rules, and deferred surface statuses; it does not implement every deferred adapter or delete every historical scaffold.

gap_register.gap: Some deferred surface artifacts remain in the repository as private, preview, historical, or no-new-development context.
gap_register.rationale: The cleanup policy intentionally preserves traceability and valid boundary adapters while preventing unsupported public claims.

gap_register.gap: Promotion of deferred surfaces still requires owner, audience, contract, parity, CI, packaging, and registry evidence.
gap_register.rationale: This track governs status and cleanup policy; surface-specific readiness remains owned by each binding or registry track.

description: Decide whether to keep, quarantine, or remove generated deferred surface artefacts after Cline finishes.
